whenToUse: Fine-grained satisfaction, such as for a class or consultation.
People quickly pick an approximate position.
The meanings of both ends are clear.
whenNotToUse: An exact number must be chosen (use buttons, as with NPS).
Five levels are enough (use a star rating).

alternatives.name: Range Slider
alternatives.reason: Choosing two values, a minimum and a maximum.

accessibility: It's a native range input, so the arrow keys move it one point at a time.
aria-valuetext reads it as, for example, 8 points.
The score bubble is aria-hidden, since the same value is read out.
The meanings of both ends are written as text.
